cohort_contract.selection: maximum eligible gold_count per seed; final-answer correctness and intervention outcomes unused

interpretation_contract.countscope: Require candidate-argmax or greedy donor-count adoption; positive CI alone is graded information.
interpretation_contract.continued_counting: k=1 is the single-state test; k=2/3-only success is a short trajectory or ledger result.
interpretation_contract.linear_additivity: The natural discovery geometry is restricted to occurrence 1..3 where the fit cohort has support; steering does not establish natural addition.
interpretation_contract.separator_collapse: For natural inline traces, closing-boundary damage must exceed the equal-budget opening-token control; full-event collapse is a wider generic-damage control because some token-aligned events have no non-closing payload token.
interpretation_contract.maximum_count: Compare max, source-copy, target-minus-k, and clean-target hypotheses separately.
